chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from Al-Qasim ibn Muhammad, from 'Ali, from Abi Basir, from Abi 'Abdillah عليه السلام:
For the eye of the one-eyed person, there is the full blood-money.

key_terms.الدِّيَةُ: blood-money; prescribed legal compensation for bodily injury
key_terms.الْأَعْوَرِ: a one-eyed person; someone who has only one functioning eye

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on the diyah for the eye of a one-eyed person in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning bodily injury compensation in the case of a one-eyed person. It states that if the remaining eye of a one-eyed person is harmed, the full diyah is due, showing the gravity of destroying a person's only functioning eye.
